title: philotheca nodiflora subsp. lasiocalyx
intro: Philotheca nodiflora subsp. lasiocalyx, commonly known as Lemon Ironwood, is a plant species from the Rutaceae family that is native to Western Australia. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin, reduce pain and inflammation, and combat oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Lemon Ironwood include its use as an antibacterial agent to prevent infection, a digestive aid to alleviate nausea and indigestion, and a calming agent to reduce anxiety and stress. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may provide benefits for cardiovascular health, immune function, and cognitive well-being.
